aetherStreams.description: Indoor biometric exit access area within the corporate office. The stream monitors the biometric attendance device, access-controlled exit door, employee exit pathway, and adjacent office corridor. Typical objects include employees, visitors, security personnel, access doors, biometric attendance devices, ID cards, access badges, bags, laptops, and office equipment. Common activities include employees marking exit attendance, leaving the office, access verification, visitor exit, security monitoring, and routine personnel movement. The scene also supports detection of tailgating (piggybacking), unauthorized exit, multiple people exiting on a single authentication, loitering near the exit, and other suspicious access behaviour.
